role: History screen pushed from the Dashboard: paginated, grouped (Today/Yesterday/This Week/Last Week/month) list of archive index entries with session-type, tag and text filters (state held in HistoryViewModel), swipe-delete, Ask-Flo context action, and on-tap async load of the full session into MorningResultsView or FitnessPostSummaryView.
types: EntryHistoryRow: private struct (View) — row built from SessionArchiveEntry metadata only
state: global private var napBadge/quickBadge/breatheBadge (file-scope computed views)
toplevel: `@State private var viewModel = HistoryViewModel()` (line 15) uses the default init, which binds AppDependencies.current.storage.sessionArchive and settingsManager rather than the @Environment(\.dependencies) the view reads elsewhere; SwiftUI re-evaluates that initializer expression every time the HistoryView struct is re-created by DashboardV2View (historyDestination), building and discarding a HistoryViewModel (with an ObservationLoop and an initial debounced recompute Task). #Preview (971-979) builds HistoryView with no-op closures. Only production caller: DashboardV2View.swift:513 (onDelete = MainTabView.deleteSession).

flags.text: HistoryViewModel() default arguments read AppDependencies.current (global) for archive and settings while the view uses @Environment(\.dependencies) for CloudKit/assistant/settings; an injected environment (previews, snapshot tests at EmuquTests/RemainingScreenSnapshotTests.swift:38) still lists the global archive.

Three copies of the delete sequence (archive.delete + notifyArchiveChanged + CloudKit uploadDeletion): HistoryView.confirmDelete, MainTabView.deleteSession and TrendsV2View.deleteSession; HistoryView's swipe path ignores its own onDelete parameter (which is MainTabView.deleteSession) and re-implements it.
